title: Website Developer / Website Executive
job_description:
Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, Web Development, Marketing, or related field Proven experience in website development and management Proficient in platforms such as WordPress, Shopify, Wix, or similar CMS Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and website troubleshooting Strong understanding of SEO principles and digital marketing integration Knowledge of social media marketing and advertising platforms (Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, etc.) Familiarity with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows is an advantage Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Willing to work under a 1-year contract employment Willing and able to work the normal working hours (2:30 PM – 11:30 PM) and winter season hours (3:30 PM – 12:30 AM) , with a 1-hour meal break

Design, develop, and maintain company websites to ensure functionality, performance, and responsiveness Manage website content updates including product uploads and landing pages Monitor website performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement improvements Optimize website structure and content for SEO and user experience (UX/UI) Ensure website security, backups, and system updates are properly maintained Coordinate with internal teams for digital marketing campaigns and website enhancements Manage and optimize campaigns across social media platforms (Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, etc.) Create, schedule, and monitor social media content and advertisements Analyse website traffic and campaign performance to provide improvement insights Utilize AI tools to improve workflow efficiency, content creation, and marketing performance

EPF SOCSO EIS Annual Leave Medical Claims
